(d) To provide "after school training programs" and assistance in establishing and operating community oriented commercial enterprises, such as barber shops, tailor shops, beauty salons, food store.
(e) To provide information and assistance on all social, financial, and environmental concerns of the community to the citizens, to instill a sense of pride in the community.
c. Redevelopment Objectives
(1) Physical Objectives: 
(a) Elimination of structural and environmental blight and blighting influences by acquisition and demolition of of specific areas within the Randolph Urban Renewal Area.
(b) Elimination, improvement, or realignment of city streets, alleys, and other right-of-way to alleviate through traffic, automobile congestion, on-street parking, and potentially hazardous pedestrian-vehicular conflicts.
(c) To schedule demolition and redevelopment through staging to reduce the impact of residential displacement, and to provide housing opportunities for displaced residents in decent, safe, and sanitary dwellings in keeping with Federal and State law and regulations established by the Secretary of the Department of Housing and Urban Development.
(d) To build through HUD-FHA housing subsidy programs, a variety of housing types for ownership and rental opportunities to include: townhouse ownership and apartments, garden type apartments, and single family detached housing for low and moderate income families on approximately a one to one basis with the density of Randolph existing prior to Urban Renewal Plan approval by the City Council.
(e) To provide adequate sites for service facilities and religious organizations such as a church, community center, day care center, shopping center, library and health clinic.
